title: Shanghai Port surpasses 2 million m³ LNG bunkering milestone with PIL vessel
content:
LNG Bunkering
Shanghai Port surpasses 2 million m³ LNG bunkering milestone with PIL vessel
Achievement was reached on 25 July when PIL’s “Kota Eagle” vessel received 4,549 m3 of LNG marine fuel from SIPG Energy’s LNG bunkering vessel at the Lvhuashan Anchorage off the coast of Shanghai.

Brazil launches public consultation on biofuel bunkering rules overhaul
Law firm Mayer Brown says Brazil’s ANP has launched a 45-day public consultation on proposed revisions to the country’s marine fuel specifications, paving the way for routine use of up to 100% biofuel.
